item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a manifest rewritten from a done status back to a non-done one withdraws its delivery, so the supervisor clears the grace deadline the done read set and waits on the worker as before, rather than ending it on the withdrawn delivery's clock. _reap_worker_on_its_terminal_manifest (call site dispatch.py:8702 in _run_supervisor) now sets deadline=None in the changed-manifest branch when the rewritten status is not done, before the deadline test, so a worker that rewrites complete to blocked is kept; the direct blocked/in-progress and previous-attempt-manifest cases already read as non-done and keep the deadline unset.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, carrying machine-readable baseline_suite (29cb59b0c, completed true, failure_count 0, failure_ids []) and after_suite (b4879d8b3, completed true, failure_count 0, failure_ids []), a negative_control_log naming the keep-deadline mutation, measurement_module and measurement_cwd for the base arm, and evidence_inputs restating the defect and fix. justifications.durability: the new case drives the real _run_supervisor end-to-end with a live subprocess worker and asserts the worker is still running past the grace; the declared keep-deadline mutation, which makes every manifest read count as done so the else never runs, reddens exactly that case and nothing else and nothing else (1 failed 5 deselected EXIT=1), so the guard is verified by reinstating the regression rather than by a passing suite. The test is timing-based (10 s grace, 4 s hold, 3 s poll, 15 s slack) with roughly 7 s of margin, which is adequate but not slack-free.
justifications.evidence: every claim reproduces independently: gate 6 passed EXIT=0 (gate-reproduce.log); defect reproduced on unmodified dispatch.py 29cb59b0c with the head test (reproduce-reproduce.log, 1 failed 5 deselected EXIT=1); declared mutation red (negative-control-reproduce.log, 1 failed 5 deselected EXIT=1); arms re-run at base 29cb59b0c = 15 passed and head b4879d8b3 = 16 passed, both EXIT=0, so the added-failure set difference is empty. justifications.fit: the fix is a single else branch beside the existing deadline computation, reusing the existing mtime-gated reparse and the existing done-status helper, and matches the surrounding pre-write-then-signal idiom; the comment states the mechanism (a withdrawn delivery clears the deadline) rather than naming a plan or ticket, and no added symbol carries a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.

justifications.scope_discipline: `git show --stat b4879d8b3` lists exactly the three declared paths with no extra file; the change carries nothing the goal does not imply; ruff check on dispatch.py reports 8 findings at both base and head (delta zero) and the test file is format-clean, so no lint/format finding is added.
